column1: # OpenBark known mishearings: heard<TAB>term. Written for OpenBark (Apache-2.0).
# Ways speech recognition writes a drug name that the spelling match can't reach:
# a real word ("apple" for Apoquel) or a name broken into several words. Each
# becomes a visible hint, never a change to the transcript, and for drugs only
# where the words around it are about medication (a dose, a unit, "give",
# "twice a day"...). "heard" is one to three words; "term" must be in
# veterinary.tsv. Clinics add their own in Settings, Words and drug names.
